meta.name: sdxl_cutout_lora_v1
meta.description: SDXL txt2img + LoRA + RGBA-cutout graph (T-0220, docs/design/13-asset-pipeline.md §6.15). CheckpointLoaderSimple -> LoraLoader -> CLIPTextEncode x2 + EmptyLatentImage -> KSampler -> VAEDecode -> SolidMask + JoinImageWithAlpha -> SaveImage. Produces RGBA PNG: the SolidMask (node 13) creates a uniform alpha channel (value=1.0 fully opaque by default) at the recipe's output dimensions; JoinImageWithAlpha (node 14) merges the sampled image with this alpha before SaveImage. This is the committed recipe for prop/entity sprite-cutout generation -- SolidMask.width/height are set from recipe.width/height by render_cutout_workflow() so the mask always matches the generated image. Node IDs are stable; add a new template file for graph-shape changes, never edit node IDs in place.
